requirements.text: The PriorityQueue shall implement the Os::QueueInterface for compatibility with F´ components
The PriorityQueue shall support message prioritization with higher priority messages dequeued before lower priority messages
The PriorityQueue shall allocate memory during create and deallocate it during destruction using the registered `Fw::MemAllocator`
The PriorityQueue shall use a single shared memory pool for all message priorities
The PriorityQueue shall support blocking and non-blocking send operations
The PriorityQueue shall support blocking and non-blocking receive operations
The PriorityQueue shall use Os::Mutex for thread-safe access to queue data structures
The PriorityQueue shall use Os::ConditionVariable to implement blocking send/receive
The PriorityQueue shall track high water marks for message queue depth
The PriorityQueue shall validate message sizes against the configured maximum
The PriorityQueue shall use the F´ memory allocator registry for all dynamic allocations
The PriorityQueue shall return appropriate error codes for queue full, empty, and size mismatch conditions
The PriorityQueue shall use a max-heap data structure for O(log n) priority ordering
The PriorityQueue shall NOT be ISR-safe due to mutex usage
The PriorityMemQueue shall implement the Os::QueueInterface for compatibility with F´ components
The PriorityMemQueue shall support up to 32 priority levels
The PriorityMemQueue shall allocate memory pools only for configured priority levels (sparse allocation)
The PriorityMemQueue shall support per-priority configuration of message size and depth
The PriorityMemQueue shall support blocking and non-blocking send operations
The PriorityMemQueue shall support blocking and non-blocking receive operations
The PriorityMemQueue shall dequeue messages in priority order, with the highest enabled priority serviced first
The PriorityMemQueue shall support dynamic enable/disable of individual priority levels
The PriorityMemQueue shall be configurable to be ISR-safe for message enqueue and dequeue operations
The PriorityMemQueue shall track high water marks for message queue depth
The PriorityMemQueue shall validate message sizes against priority-specific limits
The PriorityMemQueue shall use the F´ memory allocator registry for all dynamic allocations
The PriorityMemQueue shall return appropriate error codes for queue full, empty, and invalid priority conditions
The PriorityMemQueue shall provide per-priority O(1) enqueue and dequeue operations
The `Svc::ActivePhaser` component shall be active and will be woken up by an input asynchronous port call
The `Svc::ActivePhaser` component shall invoke its output ports in the order of port call registrations
The `Svc::ActivePhaser` component shall report a `MissedDeadline` warning event when a port call overruns its specified length
The `Svc::ActiveRateGroup` component shall be active and will be woken up by an input asynchronous port call
The `Svc::ActiveRateGroup` component shall invoke its output ports in order, passing the value contained in a table based on port number
The `Svc::ActiveRateGroup` component shall track the time required to execute the rate group and report it as telemetry
The `Svc::ActiveRateGroup` component shall report a warning event when a rate group cycle is started before previous is completed
The `Svc::ActiveTextLogger` component shall print received log texts to standard output.
The `Svc::ActiveTextLogger` component shall write received log texts to an optionally supplied file.
The `Svc::ActiveTextLogger` component shall format the passed log text on the calling thread context, and perform all other processing on the component's thread.
The `Svc::ActiveTextLogger` component shall stop writing to the optional file if it would exceed its max size.
The `Svc::ActiveTextLogger` component shall provide a public method to supply the filename to write to and max size.

The `Svc::ActiveTextLogger` component shall attempt to create a new file to write to if the supplied one already exists.  It will try up to ten times, by adding an integer suffix to the filename, ie "file","file0","file1"..."file9". After the last possible attempt is failed, the initial file shall be overwritten; ie if "file9" already exists, the "file" shall be truncated and used as a log file.
The `Svc::ActiveTextLogger` component shall support per-severity event filtering via a public `setSeverityFilter()` method.
The `Svc::ActiveTextLogger` component shall never filter FATAL events regardless of filter configuration.
The `Svc::AssertFatalAdapter` component shall convert all calls to FW_ASSERT to FATAL events
`BufferManager` shall allow the specification of multiple bins of buffers based on the size of the buffer
requirements.verification_method: Allows for some optimization of memory usage if buffers of varying sizes are needed|Test|

requirements.text: `BufferManager` shall allocate the first buffer with capacity at least the requested size from the set of unallocated buffers, starting with the smallest set of buffers.
requirements.verification_method: If a buffer from a smaller pool is not available, allow using larger buffers to avoid starving the user| Test|

requirements.text: `BufferManager` shall return an empty buffer (size = 0) if no buffers are available
requirements.verification_method: Allow the user to decide how to react to no memory|Test|

requirements.text: `BufferManager` shall accept empty returned buffers without an assert
requirements.verification_method: Just send a warning to cover the case where an empty buffer is returned by a component|Test

requirements.text: `BufferManager` shall use a provided Fw::MemAllocator instance to request overall buffer memory
requirements.verification_method: Let the user decide where the memory comes from|Test

requirements.text: `BufferManager` shall allow buffers to be returned in any order
requirements.verification_method: Do not restrict the lifetime or usage of buffers|Test

requirements.text: `BufferManager` shall return a buffer whose size is set exactly to the requested size
requirements.verification_method: Allow callers to use the requested size without checking the underlying allocation size|Test|

requirements.text: The `Svc::CmdDispatcher` component shall accept command buffers and decode them into commands
The `Svc::CmdDispatcher` component shall dispatch commands to components
The `Svc::CmdDispatcher` component shall provide an interface to register commands
The `Svc::CmdDispatcher` component shall process command status from components and report the results to the command buffer sender.
The `Svc::CmdDispatcher` component shall drop incoming commands to avert a queue overflow (DOS attack).
The `Svc::CmdSequencer` component shall read sequence files.
requirements.verification_method: Unit Test | CmdSequencer gets commands from the sequence file.

requirements.text: The `Svc::CmdSequencer` component shall validate the sequence files with a CRC.
requirements.verification_method: Unit Test | CmdSequencer need to know it has a valid file.

requirements.text: The `Svc::CmdSequencer` component shall provide a command to validate the sequence file.
requirements.verification_method: Unit Test | Waiting to validate the file only when running it can cause operational issues

requirements.text: The `Svc::CmdSequencer` component shall cancel the sequence upon receiving a failed command status.
requirements.verification_method: Unit Test | A sequence should not continue if a command fails since subsequent commands may depend on the outcome

requirements.text: The `Svc::CmdSequencer` component shall provide a command to cancel the existing sequence
requirements.verification_method: Unit Test | Operator should be able to cancel the sequence if it is hung or needs to be stopped.

requirements.text: The `Svc::CmdSequencer` component shall provide an overall sequence timeout.
requirements.verification_method: Unit Test | Sequencer should quit if a component fails to send a command response

requirements.text: `DpCatalog` shall read a set of directories and build a catalog of data products.
requirements.verification_method: `DpCatalog` needs to know at least one directory where data products reside | Test

requirements.text: `DpCatalog` shall sort data products first based on the internally recorded priority where the highest priority is represented by the lowest number.
requirements.verification_method: `DpCatalog` needs to downlink highest priority items first | Test

requirements.text: `DpCatalog` shall sort data products second based on the internally recorded time with oldest products as higher priority.
requirements.verification_method: `DpCatalog` needs to downlink oldest items first | Test

requirements.text: `DpCatalog` shall sort data products third based on the internally recorded product ID with the lowest as higher priority.
requirements.verification_method: `DpCatalog` needs to resolve case where priority and time match | Test

requirements.text: `DpCatalog` shall update the data product metadata once download is complete
requirements.verification_method: `DpCatalog` needs to track completion status to avoid duplicate downloads | Test

requirements.text: `DpCatalog` shall implement a command and port to build the catalog.
requirements.verification_method: `DpCatalog` should consume the resources to build the catalog only when needed | Test

requirements.text: `DpCatalog` shall implement a command and port to start downloading the catalog.
requirements.verification_method: `DpCatalog` downloads should be timed for when communications are ready, and not consume comm window time building | Test

requirements.text: `DpCatalog` shall have filters for the download based on container ID, priority, and data size limit.
requirements.verification_method: `DpCatalog` downloads should be tunable for available bandwidth and container metadata | Test

requirements.text: `DpCatalog` shall implement a way to insert newly-generated data products into the catalog after the catalog is built
requirements.verification_method: `DpCatalog` should notice new products and not require a rebuild of the catalog | Test

requirements.text: `DpCatalog` shall implement commands to modify the priority of existing data products
requirements.verification_method: Operators made change the priority to lower or raise priorities due to troubleshooting, etc | Test

requirements.text: `DpCatalog` shall implement commands to delete data products
requirements.verification_method: Ground tools can use DpManager commands to automatically delete DPs | Test

requirements.text: `DpCatalog` shall implement a catalog data product that is a listing of existing data products and their metadata
requirements.verification_method: Allow operators to know what products exist | Test

requirements.text: `DpCatalog` shall have filters for the catalog data product for priority, container ID, and time range
requirements.verification_method: Allow operators to know what products exist | Test

requirements.text: `Svc::DpManager` shall provide an array of ports for synchronously requesting and receiving data product buffers.
requirements.verification_method: This capability supports the `product` `get` port in the auto-generated code for components that define data products. | Unit test

requirements.text: `Svc::DpManager` shall provide arrays of ports for receiving and asynchronously responding to requests for data product buffers.
requirements.verification_method: This capability supports the `product` `request` and `product` `recv` ports in the auto-generated code for components that define data products. | Unit test

requirements.text: `Svc::DpManager` shall receive data product buffers and forward them for further processing.
requirements.verification_method: This requirement provides a pass-through capability for sending data product buffers to downstream components. `Svc::DpManager` receives data product input on a port of type  `Fw::DpSend`. This input consists of a container ID and an `Fw::Buffer` _B_. `Svc::DpManager` sends _B_ on a port of type `Fw::BufferSend`. This port type is used by the standard F Prime components for managing and logging data, e.g., `Svc::BufferAccumulator`, `Svc::DpWriter`. | Unit test

requirements.text: `Svc::DpManager` shall provide telemetry that reports the number of successful allocations, the number of failed allocations, and the volume of data handled.
requirements.verification_method: This requirement establishes the telemetry interface for the component. | Unit test

requirements.text: `Svc::DpWriter` shall provide a port for receiving `Fw::Buffer` objects pointing to filled data product containers.
requirements.verification_method: The purpose of `DpWriter` is to write the data products to disk. | Unit Test

requirements.text: `Svc::DpWriter` shall provide an array of ports for sending `Fw::Buffer` objects for processing.
requirements.verification_method: This requirement supports downstream processing of the data in the buffer. | Unit Test

requirements.text: On receiving a data product container _C_, `Svc::DpWriter` shall use the processing type field of the header of _C_ to select zero or more processing ports to invoke, in port order.
requirements.verification_method: The processing type field is a bit mask. A one in bit `2^n` in the bit mask selects port index `n`. | Unit Test

requirements.text: On receiving an `Fw::Buffer` _B_, and after performing any requested processing on _B_, `Svc::DpWriter` shall write _B_ to disk.
requirements.verification_method: The purpose of `DpWriter` is to write data products to the disk. | Unit Test

requirements.text: `Svc::DpWriter` shall provide a port for notifying other components that data products have been written.
requirements.verification_method: This requirement allows `Svc::DpCatalog` or a similar component to update its catalog in real time. | Unit Test

requirements.text: `Svc::DpManager` shall provide telemetry that reports the number of buffers received, the number of data products written, the number of bytes written, the number of failed writes, and the number of errors.
requirements.verification_method: This requirement establishes the telemetry interface for the component. | Unit test

requirements.text: On receiving an `Fw::Buffer` _B_, and after performing any requested processing on _B_, `Svc::DpWriter` shall re-parse the container header and shrink the size of the product.
requirements.verification_method: Allows processing interfaces to compress data products and communicate that compressed state back to `Svc::DpWriter`. | Unit Test

requirements.text: The `Svc::EventManager` component shall receive events and compose them into downlink packets.
The `Svc::EventManager` component shall have commands to filter events based on event severity.
The `Svc::EventManager` component shall have commands to filter events based on the event ID.
The `Svc::EventManager` component shall call fatalOut port when FATAL is received
The `Svc::FatalHandler` component shall handle FATAL notifications
The `Svc::FatalHandler` component shall shut down the Unix process
The `Svc::FatalHandler` component shall suspend the thread calling FATAL
`FileDownlink` shall queue up a list of files to downlink
requirements.verification_method: The requirement provides the ability to simultaneously queue up multiple files for downlink from different sources | Test

requirements.text: `FileDownlink` shall read a file from non-volatile storage, partition the file into packets, and send out the packets.
requirements.verification_method: This requirement provides the capability to downlink files from the spacecraft. | Test

requirements.text: `FileDownlink` shall wait for a cooldown after completing a file downlink before starting another file downlink
requirements.verification_method: Allows a saturated link to process a backlog that may have built up during a file downlink | Test

requirements.text: `FileDownlink` shall issue a warning if a file with zero size is encountered
requirements.verification_method: Ensures that operators are aware of invalid file sizes | Test

requirements.text: `FileUplink` shall receive file packets, assemble them into files, and store the files in the on-board non-volatile storage.
requirements.verification_method: This requirement provides the capability to uplink files to the spacecraft. | Unit Test, System Test

requirements.text: `FileUplink` shall announce the completion of uplinked files.
requirements.verification_method: This requirement provides the capability to inform other components of newly uplinked files | Unit Test, System Test

requirements.text: `Svc::FprimeDeframer` shall extract the payload field from input buffers that represent a valid F Prime frame as specified by the [F Prime Protocol](../../FprimeProtocol/docs/sdd.md)
requirements.verification_method: Deframe valid frames and extract payload | Unit test |

requirements.text: `Svc::FprimeDeframer` shall return ownership of input buffers that are not a valid F Prime frame as specified by the [F Prime Protocol](../../FprimeProtocol/docs/sdd.md)
`Svc::FprimeRouter` shall route packets based on their packet type as indicated by the packet header
requirements.verification_method: Routing mechanism of the F´ comms protocol | Unit test |

requirements.text: `Svc::FprimeRouter` shall route packets of type `Fw::ComPacketType::FW_PACKET_COMMAND` to the `commandOut` output port.
`Svc::FprimeRouter` shall route packets of type `Fw::ComPacketType::FW_PACKET_FILE` to the `fileOut` output port.
`Svc::FprimeRouter` shall route data that is neither `Fw::ComPacketType::FW_PACKET_COMMAND` nor `Fw::ComPacketType::FW_PACKET_FILE` to the `unknownDataOut` output port.
requirements.verification_method: Allows for projects to provide custom routing for additional (project-specific) uplink data types | Unit test |

requirements.text: `Svc::FprimeRouter` shall emit warning events if serialization errors occur during processing of incoming packets
requirements.verification_method: Aid in diagnosing uplink issues | Unit test |

requirements.text: `Svc::FprimeRouter` shall pass through buffers for `FW_PACKET_FILE` and unknown packet types without copying, and defer returning them to the deframer until they are returned via `fileBufferReturnIn`
`Svc::FprimeRouter` shall return ownership of all buffers received on `dataIn` through `dataReturnOut`

`Svc::FprimeRouter` shall preserve the `ComCfg::FrameContext` received on `dataIn` and restore it on the corresponding `dataReturnOut`, including across the `fileOut`/`unknownDataOut` → `fileBufferReturnIn` round-trip
requirements.verification_method: Allows a shared router to return buffers to the correct originating uplink path (e.g. by `vcId`) | Unit test |

requirements.text: `Svc::FprimeRouter` shall emit a warning event and return the buffer with an empty context when the buffer-to-context table is full on hand-off, or when a returned buffer is not found in the table
requirements.verification_method: Graceful degradation without loss of buffer ownership | Unit test |

requirements.text: `Svc::FrameAccumulator` shall accumulate a sequence of byte buffers until a full frame is received
requirements.verification_method: FrameAccumulator is designed to re-assemble frames from sequence of bytes | Unit test |

requirements.text: `Svc::FrameAccumulator` shall detect once the accumulated buffers form a full frame and emit said frame
requirements.verification_method: Pass frames to other parts of the system | Unit test |

requirements.text: `Svc::FrameAccumulator` shall accept byte buffers containing frames that are not aligned on a buffer boundary.
requirements.verification_method: For flexibility, we do not require that the frames be aligned on a buffer boundary. | Unit test |

requirements.text: `Svc::FrameAccumulator` shall accept byte buffers containing frames that span one or more buffers.
requirements.verification_method: For flexibility, we do not require each frame to fit in a single buffer. | Unit test |
